name: WCORR-WEB-001: Web reconnaissance followed by exploitation attempt
description: This rule correlates reconnaissance and exploitation indicators originating from the same recorded HTTP client IP against the same Wazuh-monitored endpoint.
query:
sequence by agent.id.keyword, data.srcip.keyword
with maxspan=10m
  [any where rule.id.keyword in
    ("31151", "31515", "31516")
    and data.srcip.keyword != null]
  [any where rule.id.keyword in
    ("31103", "31104", "31105", "31110",
     "31164", "31166", "31168")
    and data.srcip.keyword != null]
author: Wazuh EQL Correlation
false_positives: Same recorded client IP does not confirm exploitation. Historical attribution is uncertain because the recorded client address also represented the server public address; reverse proxies can link unrelated activity.
setup: Collect HTTP reconnaissance and exploitation alerts; validate recorded client IP attribution through proxies.
